staticChecks.check: Plan/evidence are valid JSON and contain the expected top-level schema.
Every acceptance criterion maps to existing fixtures; every fixture acceptance ID resolves.
Every gate fixture reference resolves; every fixture and gate is NOT_RUN with empty evidence.
Every fixture openQuestionRef resolves to a declared OPEN_QUESTION.
Direct dependencies exactly match T29 card and observed states match docs/progress.json; no dependency is accepted.
S25 operational recovery and S27 portable subscenarios are explicitly mapped without claiming T19/T25 synthetic-core or native-device acceptance.

Error, cancel, capacity, permission, plaintext warning, manifest/checksum, originals, new IDs/key/re-encryption, no auto-upload, trash mapping, durable job, VersionId confirmation, ledger, isolation, deletion fences, epoch/bootstrap, privacy canary and workspace scope are represented.
Task-card commands are listed but NOT_RUN; missing current code paths/script are recorded as prerequisites.
No test/build/network/provider/database/account/user-data/profile/delete/import/export/restore operation or production/progress edit is claimed.
Self-check is distinguished from required independent critical review and behavior acceptance.

F12 separates localDBKey from workspace-derived cloud content key and states that any later cloud manifest uses a fresh nonce/AAD; F22 cloud-trash restoration uses workspace content key, never localDBKey.
F50 covers export process crash/restart and prevents partial output from being represented as complete; cleanup/resume remains OQ04.
F34 and T29-A09 distinguish backup retention and copy-purge state from provider cancellation/data deletion, with durations under OQ13.
No fixture sourceRefs contains a T29-OQ identifier; in particular F25 keeps OQ05/OQ08/OQ09 only in openQuestionRefs.

structuralAuditMethod: Parsed both JSON artifacts, then checked ID uniqueness, reference closure, acceptance/gate mapping, empty evidence/status invariants, dependency statuses against the progress snapshot, key separation assertions, crash fixture, backup-retention separation, and F25 source-reference hygiene. This is artifact-structure checking only, not a behavior test. The final pass also deduplicated fixture specification references and confirmed no OQ identifiers are misfiled as sourceRefs.
